en-US.description: Transform your USB and IP cameras into an automated surveillance system with this program. Detect motion, trigger alarms, save image evidence, and easily tune sensitivity to avoid false alerts.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft Webcam Motion Detector is a customizable security utility built for automated movement tracking. Ideal for securing a home, monitoring an office, or watching a specific area, this app turns your standard cameras into a highly responsive motion-detection system.

Key Features:
* Broad Camera Compatibility: The software supports local USB webcams as well as network-based IP cameras. The "Camera List" allows you to easily manage and connect to remote feeds using direct URL, or host IP address with port configuration.
* Automated Alerts & Evidence Capture: Configure the software to take immediate action the moment motion is detected. You can set it to "Play Sound" to act as a local alarm, or automatically "Save Image" to capture and store visual evidence (timestamped JPEG file) of the triggering event in a designated local directory.
* Detection Settings: Fine-tune the software's sensitivity to avoid false alarms using the dedicated settings panel, which allows you to adjust the amount of noise reduction to filter out background static, set the detection threshold to determine how significant movement must be to trigger the alarm, and customize motion detection areas by defining internal grid dimensions and setting a required count of changed neighbor areas to ensure only genuine motion registers as an event.
* Visual Filters: Apply real-time visual filters to your camera feed, such as "Emboss" or "Edge" detect, which can highlight moving subjects or outlines more clearly depending on your lighting conditions.

With its user-friendly interface and robust underlying settings, This program provides an accessible yet powerful way to set up personalized video surveillance without the need for expensive, proprietary security hardware.
en-US.name: Vovsoft Webcam Motion Detector
